title: One Recruitment menu link
summary: The menu now has one Recruitment link. It opens the right Recruitment page for each account.
changes: Replace the separate Recruitment and Recruit manage menu links with one Recruitment link.
Open Roles for Human Resources, Admin, and Super Admin accounts, and Open roles for everyone else who can use Recruitment.
Keep the Recruitment link highlighted on both public and manage Recruitment pages.
Retire the Recruit manage wording from page titles and the glossary.
version_rationale: Patch on the 0.41 line: a compatible navigation change with no new pages or permissions.
validation: Recruitment menu tests for visitors, public, staff, Human Resources, Admin, Super Admin, and review-only accounts.
Recruitment, terminology, navigation, dashboard, and layout tests.
composer pre-merge on the pull request branch.
known_limitations: Recruitment pages still show two different page submenus until a later 0.41 release.
rollback: Redeploy the previous release package. No database change is involved.
